seo.title: Oppdal ski resort guide
seo.description: Four ski areas on one mountainside between Trollheimen and Dovrefjell: 15 lifts and 30 runs in Trøndelag.
seo.twitterDescription: Four ski areas, 15 lifts and 30 runs between two mountain ranges.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Oppdal in Trøndelag, Norway.

h1: Oppdal ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Oppdal sits between Trollheimen and Dovrefjell with four ski areas on one pass: Vangslia, Stølen, Hovden and Ådalen. Fifteen lifts serve 30 runs, and the village is a stop on the Oslo-Trondheim railway.
stayOverview: Four areas on one mountainside means a group can split up in the morning and still meet for lunch. Vangslia is closest to the village; Hovden and Ådalen are the quiet ends.
hotelIntro: Book in the village or at Vangslia. The other three areas are a short drive along the same hillside.
rentalCars: Oppdal is on the Oslo-Trondheim railway, which is unusual for a Norwegian ski town, but a car helps between the four areas.
